name: Imazio et al., Efficacy and safety of colchicine for pericarditis prevention: systematic review and meta-analysis
open_access_source: Unpaywall is_oa=true; OA full text at https://heart.bmj.com/content/heartjnl/98/14/1078.full.pdf
genuinely_external: A published third-party meta-analysis (not a page produced by this harness). Trial-set overlap below is the operational test of externality.
design: 5 controlled trials (3 double-blind RCTs + 2 open-label RCTs), 795 patients, mean follow-up 13 months, I^2 = 0%.
trial_list_note: The comparator's individual trial identities are tabulated in the article body/table (not enumerated in this build). Overlap is therefore stated on the verifiable publication-date axis rather than by a fabricated shared list.

only_theirs: open-label and older trials not in our double-blind-only scope; identities not enumerated in this build
overlap.note: CORP-2 (2014) and ICAP (2013) post-date the 2012 comparator and cannot be in it (only-ours, verifiable by date). CORP (2011) is date-eligible for the comparator. Our review restricts to double-blind placebo-controlled RCTs, so open-label trials the comparator pooled are only-theirs. Exact shared count is not asserted because the comparator's trial table was not extracted in this build.
